digest.component_or_area: code review overlays — concurrency detection and routing
propositions: The concurrency overlay must be added to OVERLAY_IDS enum in registry.py to enable escalation from the base reviewer and automatic generation of include_concurrency flag.

The content_triggered_overlays function must scan both added and removed diff lines (excluding file headers) for a committed list of 43 concurrency-related tokens and return concurrency alongside deletion-impact when matches occur.
The concurrency overlay must be routed as advisory with 0.95 threshold and blocking disabled, with entries in code-review-base.md catalog and criteria_routing.json.

The code-review.yaml workflow gate must dispatch code-review-concurrency prompts in both round_a and round_b batches when include_concurrency output flag is true, following the existing per-overlay dispatch pattern.
Trigger function must fire on literals like start_new_session=True, removed sync.Mutex lines, and other tokens from the calibrated list, while excluding false-positive patterns like bare async/await.
Unit tests must verify overlay registration, trigger recall on corpus-derived diffs, routing threshold assertion, negative controls, and workflow lint validation.
